replacement.agreement_bar: >=18/20 overall AND >=4/5 agreement in every stratum
replacement.sampling: stratified 5 per stratum across reversible/read, disallowed/destructive, ambiguous-authority, credential/injection; seed committed before sampling; audit blind to Pane A labels
replacement.labeler: Pane A = WindyJaguar/pane 2, non-author of policy.json and non-author of implementation
replacement.auditor: Pane B = CopperCarp/pane 3, policy author/runner but blind to Pane A labels; conductor adjudicates every disagreement case-by-case

reasoning.bar: Ratified with a per-stratum floor. 18/20 is a reasonable overall screening bar for a 20-case audit, but alone allows two errors to cluster in one stratum and pass.
reasoning.power: A uniform random 20-of-200 draw is weak against a systematically mislabeled stratum: expected about five per stratum but can under-sample or miss a stratum. Stratified 5-per-stratum guarantees representation; the 4/5 floor catches a systematic two-error stratum even when total agreement is 18/20.
reasoning.limitation: This remains an audit screen, not proof of 95% population accuracy. If a stratum fails its floor or total agreement falls below 18/20, redo labels with the adjudicated rubric; do not average disagreement into agreement.
reasoning.seed: Commit the sampling seed and case IDs before Pane B samples; labels are frozen before audit.

thresholds.api_cost: ~$0.037 for 2000 calls at 435 input tokens and $0.042/Mtok
